```markdown
## lock-closures-roadmap — 2026-11-06

- [ ] Closure notices (lock-closures-roadmap Stage 2, Track B, O5; ROUTING writing-plans)
      Boat operators get an email notice within an hour of a lock closing. Reads the closure log's live feed. Text-message notices are not included.
      Size: small, one plan cycle; one closure-log poll every 10 minutes.
      Done when: the notice job and its operator mailing list exist, and in a test an email reaches every address on the list within an hour of a new closure entry.

- [ ] 7-day closure-risk outlook (lock-closures-roadmap Ranked list A #1, O2)
      A 7-day closure-risk outlook for each lock from the river-level forecast. Builds on Stage 1's response curve (specs/lock-closures-stage-1-findings.md: closures rise steeply above a 3.1 m gauge level).
      Size: small; one model run a day. Stage 1's fit took 22 min on 1.8 GB.
      Done when: a 7-day closure-risk outlook exists for each lock from the river-level forecast, with its findings file recording the result and the measured cost of the real run.

- [ ] Per-lock closure curves, pooled (lock-closures-roadmap Ranked list A #2, O3)
      Separate closure curves for all 14 locks, pooled across locks. Stage 1 found the four longest-record locks show close to the same curve.
      Size: about 14 times Stage 1's data (1.8 GB).
      Done when: pooled closure curves for all 14 locks exist, with their findings file recording the result and the measured cost of the real run.

- [ ] Closure-history map (lock-closures-roadmap Ranked list A #3, O4)
      A closure-history map for the canal's boat operators.
      Size: about a day; one static map page.
      Done when: the map page shows each lock's closure history.
```
